title: puse, hice, vine, traje; fui (ser and ir); fueron; past mood from irregulars

cards.title: poner → pus-
cards.body: The -pose of compose / expose shows up here. Irregular endings are not stressed: puse, not 'pusé'.

cards.title: hacer → hic-
cards.body: Hizo is spelled with z (hico would sound wrong).

examples.en: I did / he did / they did

cards.title: fui = I was / I went
cards.body: Ser and ir share the same dot past: fui, fue, fuimos, fuiste, fueron. The i drops in fueron, as in dijeron and trajeron, just for ease of saying.

examples.en: I didn't go. / He didn't go.
we went / you went / they went

cards.title: Si yo fuera tú = if I were you
cards.body: Building the past mood tense from the 'they' form carries the irregularity over: fueron → fuera, dijeron → dijera, tuvieron → tuviera.

examples.es: Si yo fuera tú … / Si yo fuera usted …

examples.en: If I had it, I'd tell you.
examples.es: Si lo tuviera, te lo contaría.

cards.title: quería que lo hicieran
cards.body: Don't fear mistakes: build verbs as usual and, if you suspect an irregular, check with the person you're talking to.

examples.en: I wanted them to do it.
I wanted us to do it.

practice.en: If I had it, I'd tell you (informal).
es: Si lo tuviera te lo contaría
Si lo tuviera te lo diría

practice.en: I wanted them to do it.
